Let Roblox's playtest agent play this game? The task and what it sees of the place go to Roblox, and it runs on your Roblox account, against its daily limit. It plays in Roblox Studio and reports back.

Publish an update of this game's place to Roblox? This game's chat clicks File › Publish to Roblox in Roblox Studio with computer control. Everyone who plays the game gets the update, and it is published on your Roblox account.

Publish this game to Roblox for the first time, under the name shown? This game's chat clicks File › Publish to Roblox in Roblox Studio with computer control and keeps the privacy Studio gives a new game. It is published on your Roblox account.
Quit Roblox Studio? Studio asks you to save your place first, as it always does.

Retexture a mesh with Roblox's AI? The prompt and the mesh go to Roblox, and it runs on your Roblox account. The new texture replaces the mesh's own in this game's place, and Roblox moderates it on your Roblox account.
Send a picture to Roblox for its AI tools? The picture goes to Roblox under your Roblox account, so its AI tools can use it as a reference.
Split a mesh into parts with Roblox's AI? The mesh and the part names go to Roblox, and it runs on your Roblox account. The parts are added to this game's place next to the mesh.

Take back what Genex set up in Roblox Studio: the Genex helper in its Plugins folder (and that folder, if Genex made it) and the MCP server switch Genex turned on. Anything changed since stays as it is.

Upload pictures to your Roblox account? The pictures go to Roblox as your assets, and Roblox moderates them: a refused picture counts against your Roblox account. Each comes back as an asset id this game can use.
